    StartersHummell's gingerbread menSpiced golden syrup gingerbread cookies, decorated with icingHow to make it125g butter100g brown sugar120g golden syrup375g plain flour1 tsp bicarbonate of soda3 tsp ground ginger1 egg100g icing sugar1 tbsp lemon juiceHeat the oven to 180°C and line trays. Melt the butter, sugar and golden syrup.Stir into the flour, bicarbonate of soda and ginger with the egg.Chill, roll 5mm thick and cut 20 men.Bake until just firm.Cool and pipe buttons with icing sugar mixed with lemon juice.Parade float popcornWhite chocolate popcorn. Dementor jumps the parade float.How to make it100g popcorn kernels2 tbsp vegetable oil150g white chocolate, melted2 tbsp red and green sprinkles1 pinch of flaky saltPop the kernels in the vegetable oil in a large lidded pot and spread on a lined tray.Melt the white chocolate.Drizzle over the popcorn and toss.Scatter with sprinkles and salt before it sets.Break into clusters.MainsMickey's Diner beef gem hotdishCreamy beef and mushroom casserole under crisp tater tots and cheddarHow to make it600g beef mince1 onion, diced200g mushrooms, sliced250ml thickened cream500g frozen tater tots100g cheddar, gratedBrown the mince with the onion and mushrooms.Stir in the cream and simmer until thick.Tip into a dish and cover with tater tots and cheddar.Bake at 200°C until crisp.Langstons' maple-glazed Christmas Eve hamThe family Christmas in the Minnesota coldHow to make itAs written, serves 4Leg ham scored and glazed with maple, mustard and orange, roasted sticky and dark, with buttery mash, honey carrots and a cranberry relish.Heat the oven to 180°C.Peel the rind off a 3kg cooked half leg ham, score the fat in diamonds and stud with cloves.Simmer 125ml maple syrup, 2 tbsp Dijon, the juice of an orange and 2 tbsp brown sugar for 3 minutes.Roast the ham for 50 minutes, brushing with glaze every 15 minutes.Serve with mash, carrots roasted in honey and cranberry sauce stirred with orange zest.SweetsPeppermint barkDark and white chocolate layers with crushed candy canesHow to make it200g dark chocolate, melted200g white chocolate1 drop peppermint extract6 candy canes, crushedLine a tray with baking paper and spread the dark chocolate thin.Set.Melt the white chocolate with the peppermint extract and spread over.Scatter with crushed candy canes and set again.Break into shards.Ted's too-perfect iced Christmas cookiesIced cookies. "Put that cookie down! Now!"How to make itAs written, serves 4Crisp vanilla butter cookies cut into stars and trees, iced with flawless white royal icing and finished with silver cachous and sprinkles.Beat 200g soft butter with 150g caster sugar, then 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla.Mix in 350g plain flour and a pinch of salt, chill 30 minutes, roll 5mm thick and cut stars and trees.Bake at 180°C for 9 minutes and cool.Beat 1 egg white with 250g icing sugar and lemon juice to thick icing, pipe outlines, flood the centres and decorate with cachous and sprinkles.DrinksTurbo Time spiced eggnogHomemade custard eggnog with cinnamon, nutmeg and maple, topped with whipped creamHow to make it5 egg yolks80g caster sugar500ml milk250ml thickened cream1 cinnamon stick1 pinch of nutmeg1 tbsp maple syrup1 tsp vanilla extract100ml whipped cream, to serveWhisk the yolks and sugar until pale.Heat the milk and cream with the cinnamon and nutmeg until steaming.Whisk into the yolks, return to the pan and stir over low heat to 75°C until it coats the spoon.Strain and stir in the maple syrup and vanilla.Chill.Serve topped with whipped cream and more nutmeg.
